purpose: Real hook stdin payloads captured from vendor CLIs for M91 lane P golden fixtures (AGENTS rule 13: contracts come from real output). Every key, nesting, order, type and value is as the vendor sent it except the scrubbed values listed under scrub.
recorder: node rec.js <Event>: writes the raw stdin bytes and the sorted environment variable NAMES (never values), prints nothing to stdout, exits 0

rules: workspace directory -> /workspace (Linux) or C:\workspace (Windows); absolute paths stay absolute, relative tool paths (e.g. hello.txt) stay relative

transcript paths -> /home/user/.gemini/tmp/workspace/chats/session-000N.jsonl (Gemini) and C:\Users\user\.claude\projects\C--workspace\session-000N.jsonl (Claude); directory shape and .jsonl extension kept
session UUIDs -> session-000N; Claude prompt_id UUID -> prompt-000N; Claude tool_use_id -> toolu_placeholder000N (all stay strings)
every other value (timestamps, tool inputs and outputs, model text, token counts, PGID) is unchanged
scrub.serialisation: vendors send compact single-line JSON; fixtures are re-serialised with 2-space indentation and a trailing newline (key order preserved)
scrub.truncation: only gemini/AfterTool.grep_search.json: strings longer than 300 chars (llmContent and match lines that quote other capture files) cut to 200 chars plus the marker '…[truncated]'; array lengths and keys unchanged. No other file is truncated.
scrub.grepCheck: zero hits in captured/ for the owner's user name (either case), the Google API key prefix, the OpenAI-style secret key prefix, gmail addresses and GitHub personal/OAuth token prefixes, and zero remaining UUIDs
scrub.rawCopies: unscrubbed captures, CLI stdout/stderr and session transcripts stay only in the session scratchpad (m91p-capture/), not in the repo
scrub.prettier: files were run through the repo's prettier (formatting only; no value changed)

observations.versusDocs: contradicts the docs ('Other' exit codes are a non-fatal warning and the action goes ahead); matches hookRunner.convertPlainTextToHookOutput in the 0.62.0 bundle: exit 0 text -> allow + systemMessage, exit 1 -> allow + 'Warning: <text>', exit >= 2 -> deny with reason = stdout.trim() || stderr.trim()

observations.modelSaw: the real tool output (functionResponse {"output":"hello capture\n"}); nothing from the hook
observations.versusDocs: matches the docs' 'pollution' rule (allow, whole output shown as systemMessage)

surprisesVersusDocs: In -p mode --skip-trust alone did not load project hooks (zero captures); exporting GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE=true before launch did. The 0.62.0 bundle sets that env var only after parsing arguments, which looks too late for settings loading.
PreCompress fired with trigger 'auto' once per model turn (3 in run1, 10 in runA-contract) even though nothing was compressed; retries did not fire it again.
transcript_path is a .jsonl file under ~/.gemini/tmp/<project>/chats/ (the docs say 'session transcript JSON').

llm_request has no toolConfig key and no system message. messages holds only the first user text (with the <session_context> preamble); model turns and function call/response turns never appear, so later BeforeModel payloads match the first apart from timestamp. config = {temperature, topP, topK}.

llm_response has an undocumented top-level 'text' key; candidates[] carry 'index'; parts are plain strings; finishReason appears only on the last chunk; thought summaries arrive as ordinary text parts; the chunk carrying the function call has parts []; one chunk was just {"candidates":[]}; usageMetadata has promptTokenCount/candidatesTokenCount/totalTokenCount (the docs show only totalTokenCount).
AfterModel fired for every streamed chunk (2-5 per successful request in run1), as documented; it did not fire for failed attempts.

BeforeTool/AfterTool for built-in tools have no mcp_context or original_request_name keys (documented as optional). AfterTool tool_response = {llmContent, returnDisplay} with no 'error' key. returnDisplay is a string for read_file, run_shell_command and glob but an object for list_directory {summary, files[]} and grep_search {summary, matches[]}.

run_shell_command tool_input = {description, command} (the model fills in 'description'); llmContent wraps shell output as '<untrusted_context>
Output: hi
Process Group PGID: N
</untrusted_context>'.
AfterTool does not fire when BeforeTool blocks the tool.
AfterAgent prompt_response kept leading whitespace and newlines ('   \n   \nDone ').

Hook env includes GEMINI_API_KEY (redaction is off by default, as documented), plus GEMINI_CWD, GEMINI_PLANS_DIR, GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR, GEMINI_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, GEMINI_CLI_NO_RELAUNCH. SSH_* and GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE names come from the capture harness.
-m gemini-3.5-flash silently ran as gemini-3.8-flash (getBackendModelMappings maps the base flash model to the latest one); llm_request.model shows the mapped name.
On first sight the CLI warns about new project hooks on stderr and records them as 'name:command' in ~/.gemini/trusted_hooks.json; non-interactive runs go ahead anyway.
